news.title: Rezolve Ai Proves at-Scale Intelligence at the 2026 Football World Cup: 103 Million App Opens, 5.8 Million Location Events and 16 Stadiums
news.lede: Live deployment connects global digital attention with physical-world presence, validating a powerful new context layer for agentic commerce. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rezolve Ai (NASDAQ: RZLV), a global leader in AI-powered commerce infrastructure, today announced production-scale results from its technology operating within the Football World Cup 2026 app, demonstrating the ability to connect global digital attention with physical-world presence in real time. Between June 1 and July 31, 2026, Rezolve Ai technology processed approximately 103 million app opens from 9,856,890 unique devices worldwide and recorded 5,843,597 geofence entry events from 1,119,546 unique devices at outer perimeters around all 16 tournament stadiums.

news.title: Zion Suzuki: From Asian Cup racism to World Cup star and Premier League history man
news.lede: Visiting Hong Kong this month with his former club Juventus, Lilian Thuram tackled the subject of racism in football. A World Cup winner for France, Thuram has his own eponymous foundation to educate people about racism, and has authored books on the topic. “When I was a child it was a problem, now my children [professional footballers Marcus and Khephren] have the same problem,” Thuram told the South China Morning Post. “Probably, nobody has managed to find a way to solve it.”

news.title: NFF Sets Up Panel To Probe Super Falcons’ World Cup Failure, Nigeria’s Recent Football Setbacks
news.lede: NFF inaugurates panel to investigate Super Falcons’ World Cup failure and broader national team setbacks, seeking solutions to Nigeria’s football crisis. The President of the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF), Alhaji Ibrahim Musa Gusau, MON, has inaugurated the Federation’s newly constituted Fact-finding Committee on Nigeria Football Setbacks, charging members to carry out a thorough investigation with sincerity, diligence and a strong sense of responsibility. The committee was inaugurated on Monday following the Super Falcons’ failure to qualify for next year’s FIFA Women’s World Cup, with the NFF seeking to identify the root causes of Nigeria’s recent poor performances in international competitions.

news.title: World Cup stadium could be demolished as consultation is launched on future of 35,950-seater ground
news.lede: HELLAS VERONA’S stadium, the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi, is set to be demolished and rebuilt smaller – but more modern – in time for Euro 2032. Italy hosts the 19th iteration of the Euros along with Turkey and this stadium was actually used when they hosted the World Cup in 1990. Back then, an extra tier of seating and a roof was added to the ground, but now, the stadium must be updated. Damiano Tommasi, a former Italy international and Roma legend – who also started his career at Verona – is now the mayor of the city and is tasked with developing the project.

news.title: How south west London watched a World Cup from across the Atlantic
news.lede: For a tournament played four or five thousand miles away, the 2026 World Cup left a surprisingly deep mark on south west London. From packed beer gardens in Wandsworth to living rooms in Kingston where the football did not kick off until the children were long asleep, the summer’s football rearranged the rhythm of daily life across the boroughs in ways a European tournament never quite manages. A World Cup on the other side of the Atlantic is a different creature, and the way local communities adapted to it says something about how football is actually lived here. The tournament ran from the middle of June to the middle of July, staged across the United States, Canada and Mexico, and the geography changed everything about how it was consumed.
